headline: Six Fronts Swirl as Bases Change Hands
war_summary: Three hours after the last dispatch the fighting remains concentrated on the same half‑dozen corridors. Callahans Passage still leads the bloodletting, adding roughly 15,000 Colonial and 16,000 Warden dead in the past day and recording 22 base exchanges, the most recent only seconds ago. Weathered Expanse follows with about 13,000 Colonial and 19,000 Warden casualties and 35 ownership changes, the latest minutes ago. Palantine Berm and Nevish Line each logged over 1,000 casualties per side and 30‑plus flips, while Stlican Shelf and Kuura Strand saw 20‑plus and 14 events respectively. Hourly casualty rates are accelerating on Callahans, Palantine and Kuura, but cooling on Weathered, Stlican and Nevish; enlistments are rising on Palantine and Kuura and falling elsewhere. The remaining sectors stay largely static, held wholly by one faction with only low‑level attrition and no ownership activity.
